blocks.text: Assalam o alaikum! Pichhle section 14.1 mein humne vectors ko jama (add) karna, kisi scalar (sirf number) se multiply karna, magnitude (lambai) nikalna aur direction cosines dekhe. Ab sawal yeh hai: kya do vectors ko aapas mein multiply bhi kiya ja sakta hai? Jawab hai haan, aur woh bhi do tareeqon se. Is section 14.2 mein hum pehla tareeqa seekhenge: dot product, jise scalar product bhi kehte hain.

Kitab yahan ek chhota sa paragraph deti hai. Woh kehti hai ke do vectors ko aapas mein multiply karna vector algebra ka ek ahem algebraic amal (operation) hai, aur bohat si physical aur mathematical real-life soorat-e-haal samajhne mein is ka bunyaadi kirdaar hai. Numbers ki zarb ka sirf ek hi tareeqa hota hai: \(3 \times 4 = 12\), bas. Lekin vectors ki zarb do alag tareeqon se hoti hai. In do bunyaadi qismon ke naam hain dot product aur cross product. Dot product ka jawab ek scalar number hota hai, jab ke cross product ka jawab ek vector quantity hoti hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Do tareeqe kyun? Kyun ke vector mein do cheezein hoti hain: lambai aur simt. Kabhi humein sirf yeh jaanna hota hai ke do vectors "kitne ek doosre ki simt mein" hain; is ka jawab ek number hai, aur yeh kaam dot product karta hai (14.2). Kabhi humein do vectors se ek naya vector chahiye jo dono ke perpendicular ho, jaise pench (bolt) ghumane wala torque; yeh kaam cross product karta hai (14.3). Yaad rakhne ka aasan tareeqa: dot ka jawab "dot" jaisa chhota sa number, cross ka jawab teer wala vector.

Upar wala paragraph kitab mein Exercise 14.1 ke baad aur heading 14.2 se zara pehle chhapa hai. Phir heading 14.2 Dot or Scalar Product ke foran baad 14.2.1 shuru ho jata hai; 14.2 ke neeche alag se kuch nahin likha. Neeche ke notes, naqsha aur lists hamari taraf se hain: poore section ka chhota sa guide, taa ke aap ko pata ho ke aage kya aa raha hai aur kyun.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Dot product hai kya? Yeh do vectors ko multiply karne ka aisa tareeqa hai jis ka jawab ek akela number (scalar) hota hai, vector nahin. Agar \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) ke darmiyan angle \(\theta\) ho to:
\[\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v} = |\underline{u}||\underline{v}|\cos\theta\]
Yeh number batata hai ke dono vectors kis had tak ek hi taraf ishara kar rahe hain. Angle chhota (acute) ho to jawab positive, dono perpendicular (amood, 90 darje) hon to jawab zero, aur angle bara (obtuse) ho to jawab negative.
Ek misaal se sochiye: aap ek trolley ko rassi se kheench rahe hain. Rassi agar bilkul aage ki taraf ho to aap ki saari taaqat kaam aati hai. Rassi upar ki taraf jhuki ho to taaqat ka sirf kuch hissa aage kheenchta hai. Aur agar aap seedha upar kheenchein to trolley aage bilkul nahin barhti. Yeh "kitna hissa kaam aaya" hi dot product ka asal matlab hai.
Is ki zaroorat kyun hai? Is se do vectors ke darmiyan angle nikalta hai, yeh check hota hai ke do vectors perpendicular hain ya nahin, ek vector ki doosre par projection (saya) nikalti hai, aur physics mein force ka kiya hua work (kaam) nikalta hai.

rows: \(\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v}\) ki definition angle se aur components se; Example 5
Ek vector ki doosre vector ke saath projection: \(\frac{\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v}}{|\underline{u}|}\)
Do vectors ke darmiyan angle: \(\cos\theta = \frac{\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v}}{|\underline{u}||\underline{v}|}\); Examples 12, 13

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Do vectors ek doosre ke bilkul perpendicular hon to \(\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\). To un ka dot product kya hoga? Thora sochiye, phir parhiye. Jawab: zero, chahe vectors kitne hi lambe kyun na hon. Yahi baat 14.2.6 mein perpendicular hone ka test banegi.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Do vectors ka dot product ek scalar (sirf number) hota hai.
2. Do formulas ek hi number dete hain: \(|\underline{u}||\underline{v}|\cos\theta\) (angle wala) aur \(a_{1}a_{2} + b_{1}b_{2} + c_{1}c_{2}\) (components wala).
3. Sign se angle ki qisam pata chalti hai: positive yani acute, zero yani right angle, negative yani obtuse.
4. Pehle tareeqe ko dot product (scalar product), aur doosre ko cross product (vector product) kehte hain; cross product 14.3 mein aayega.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Dot product ka jawab vector bana dena, jaise \(\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v} = 2\underline{i} + 3\underline{j}\). Dot product ke jawab mein kabhi \(\underline{i}\), \(\underline{j}\), \(\underline{k}\) nahin aate; sirf ek number aata hai.
2. Dot ( \(\cdot\) ) aur cross ( \(\times\) ) ka nishan mila dena. Dono bilkul alag operations hain, is liye nishan saaf likhiye.
